1.text: Aya magambo ndayahuguza abakuru b'Itorero bo muri mwe, kuko nanjye ndi umukuru mugenzi wanyu, n'umugabo wo guhamya imibabaro ya Kristo kandi mfatanije namwe ubwiza buzahishurwa.

2.text: Muragire umukumbi w'Imana wo muri mwe mutawurinda nk'abahatwa, ahubwo muwurinde mubikunze nk'uko Imana ishaka atari ku bwo kwifuza indamu mbi, ahubwo ku bw'umutima ukunze

3.text: kandi mudasa n'abatwaza igitugu abo mwagabanijwe, ahubwo mube ibyitegererezo by'umukumbi.

4.text: Kandi Umutahiza naboneka, muzahabwa ikamba ry'ubugingo ritangirika.

5.text: Namwe basore mugandukire abakuru. Mwese mukenyere kwicisha bugufi kugira ngo mukorerane, kuko Imana irwanya abibone naho abicisha bugufi ikabahera ubuntu.

6.text: Nuko mwicishe bugufi muri munsi y'ukuboko gukomeye kw'Imana, kugira ngo ibashyire hejuru mu gihe gikwiriye.

7.text: Muyikoreze amaganya yanyu yose, kuko yita kuri mwe.

8.text: Mwirinde ibisindisha mube maso, kuko umurezi wanyu Satani azerera nk'intare yivuga ashaka uwo aconshomera.

9.text: Mumurwanye mushikamye kandi mufite kwizera gukomeye, muzi yuko bene Data bari mu isi muhuje imibabaro.

10.text: Kandi Imana igira ubuntu bwose yabahamagariye ubwiza bwayo buhoraho buri muri Kristo, izabatunganya rwose ubwayo ibakomeze, ibongerere imbaraga nimumara kubabazwa akanya gato.

11.text: Icyubahiro n'ubutware bibe ibyayo iteka ryose. Amen.

12.text: Mbandikiye uru rwandiko rw'amagambo make, rwanditswe n'ukuboko kwa Siluwano, mwene Data wo kwizerwa, uko ntekereza mbahugura, mpamya, yuko ubuntu bw'Imana navuze ari ubw'ukuri, nimubuhagararemo mushikamye.

13.text: Itorero ry'i Babuloni ry'abatoranijwe nkamwe rirabatashya, na Mariko umwana wanjye na we arabatashya.

14.text: Mutashyanishe guhoberana k'urukundo.Amahoro abe muri mwe mwese abari muri Kristo.
